title: Injeolmi Toast with Ice Cream
shortDescription: Buttered toast is layered with warmed bite-size injeolmi, roasted soybean powder, honey, and commercial pasteurized ice cream.
culturalContext: Injeolmi toast is a modern Korean café dessert that combines toasted bread with chewy rice cake and soybean powder. Toppings and construction vary; this draft adds commercial pasteurized ice cream and foregrounds choking and melt control.
author: {{LEGAL_NAME}}

allergenNotes: verify egg, dairy, and soy label

ingredients.preparation: label checked; cut into small bite-size pieces

instructions.heading: Check labels and portions
instructions.action: Verify all packaged-food labels and keep ice cream frozen; cut injeolmi into small bite-size pieces.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Rice cake pieces are small and ice cream is firm.
instructions.safetyNote: Chewy rice cake is a choking hazard; do not serve large pieces to young children or anyone with swallowing difficulty.

instructions.heading: Butter bread
instructions.action: Spread bread lightly with butter and place on a clean tray.
instructions.safetyNote: Keep ready-to-eat ingredients away from raw-food work areas.

instructions.heading: Toast
instructions.action: Toast bread until crisp and golden.
instructions.safetyNote: Use dry oven mitts and keep the appliance attended.

instructions.heading: Warm rice cake
instructions.action: Warm bite-size injeolmi separately just until soft, following package directions.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Pieces are pliable but not melted into one mass.
instructions.safetyNote: Rice cake can become dangerously hot and sticky; test temperature before assembly.

instructions.heading: Assemble
instructions.action: Layer warm injeolmi on toast, dust with soybean powder, and drizzle with honey.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Toppings are evenly distributed in small pieces.
instructions.safetyNote: Warn diners about chewiness and supervise higher-risk diners.

instructions.heading: Add ice cream and serve
instructions.action: Using a clean scoop, add commercial pasteurized ice cream and serve immediately with a knife and fork.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Ice cream holds its shape at service.
instructions.safetyNote: Do not refreeze melted ice cream; discard portions left out beyond safe time limits.

grillSetup: No grill required; use a toaster oven or skillet on a stable, attended cooking surface.
visualDonenessCues: Rice cake is soft and divided into small pieces
Ice cream remains frozen until service
foodSafetyNotes: Use only commercial pasteurized ice cream and keep it frozen until service.
Chewy injeolmi is a choking hazard; cut small and do not serve to young children or diners with swallowing difficulty without appropriate supervision and modification.
Warm rice cake may be sticky and very hot; check temperature before serving.
Do not refreeze melted ice cream and observe time limits for perishable food.

allergens.crossContactWarning: Verify every packaged-ingredient label and segregate tools for diners with allergies.

substitutions: Use only verified allergen-appropriate bread and frozen dessert.
Omit ice cream for diners who cannot safely manage hot-and-cold mixed textures.
ingredientSourcing: Buy prepared injeolmi from a reputable refrigerated or frozen supplier and follow label storage directions.
Choose commercial pasteurized ice cream in an intact package.
makeAhead: Preportion dry toppings; toast and assemble only at service.
storage: Store each component according to its label; keep ice cream frozen and injeolmi refrigerated or frozen as directed.
reheating: Rewarm only the rice cake and toast; never heat ice cream.
leftovers: Discard assembled leftovers; do not refreeze melted ice cream or save diner-handled rice cake.
servingSuggestions: Serve immediately with a knife and fork.
Explain the chewy texture before diners take a bite.

faq.question: Why cut the injeolmi small?
faq.answer: Chewy rice cake can obstruct the airway; small pieces and careful supervision reduce, but do not eliminate, choking risk.

faq.question: Can melted ice cream be refrozen?
faq.answer: No. Keep it frozen until service and discard melted portions.
